provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

stageName.text: Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Assembly Point Before the Heart

lead.text: Stop turn 2's Blind Obsession with a skill that wins under Paralyze. Destroy Flotsam to trigger self-damage through Wayward Blind Obsession. Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit recurring Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss before it regenerates.

statNote.text: The regular Canto V encounter. Overall HP is 1102, Body HP is 882, and Fluorescent Lamp HP is 330; Part HP is not added to determine overall HP. The Lamp remains targetable and can act after breaking, then regenerates 2 turns later. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.

priorities.0.text: Prepare high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills for the first Blind Obsession, accounting for Paralyze.

priorities.1.text: Destroy Flotsam to meet the condition that changes the next Blind Obsession into Wayward Blind Obsession.

priorities.2.text: Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Normally strong E.G.O loses to Blind Obsession

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: From turn 2, 1 Paralyze sets Coin Power to 0 for one roll. Use high Base Power or negative Coins that do not rely on Plus Coin Power, or apply enemy power debuffs the turn before.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Harden nullifies damage below 12. Use strong attacks that deal at least 12 per hit rather than many small hits.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Sinking still applies after the Lamp breaks

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Fluorescence Shard prevents Siltcurrent's recurring Paralyze, Bind, and SP loss. It does not prevent all Sinking from attacks; some skills even increase Sinking Count on targets with the Shard.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare an answer to the first Blind Obsession under Paralyze

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Level 40; deployment limit 6. Turn 2's Blind Obsession rolls 15–23, with 1 Paralyze affecting your Sinners. Bring high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills.

phases.0.steps.1.text: If using Meursault's Chains of Others, land it on turn 1 to prepare turn 2's debuffs. Save its E.G.O resources and the user's SP too.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Deploying fewer Sinners can give extra slots to your main units, but fewer opening actions make the start less stable. First try 6 Sinners with assigned answers to dangerous skills and Flotsam.

phases.1.title.text: Do not try to win against the unclashable terrain change

phases.1.steps.0.text: Crashing Siltcurrent is unclashable. Powerful E.G.O cannot Clash with it to stop the terrain change. Handle regular Clashes and prepare for next turn instead.

phases.1.steps.1.text: From turn 2, Sinners without Fluorescence Shard receive 1 Paralyze, 1 Bind, and -3 SP. Use opening debuffs or healing, and save your main units' answers to Blind Obsession.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Sweep creates Flotsam at Turn End. Winning the Clash does not cancel its appearance.

phases.2.title.text: Win under Paralyze to prevent Sinking Deluge

phases.2.steps.0.text: Assign your prepared high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skill to Blind Obsession. Paralyze affects Coin rolls, so do not judge only by the skill's usual maximum.

phases.2.steps.1.text: A Sinner with multiple slots can spend Paralyze in another Clash before facing Blind Obsession. Check action order and remaining Paralyze.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Winning against Blind Obsession removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP and gives the enemy 1 Blind Obsession status. Repeated wins also help break the Part.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Do not assume Flotsam alone can always prevent the first cast. If Blind Obsession is already slotted, prepare a winning Clash.

phases.3.title.text: Destroy Flotsam before the next Blind Obsession

phases.3.steps.0.text: Flotsam has 50 HP and nullifies damage below 12. Use sufficient damage per hit to turn it into Destroyed Flotsam.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Destroyed Flotsam meets the condition for the next Blind Obsession to become Wayward Blind Obsession. Do not assume it always immediately replaces a skill the enemy has already slotted.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Wayward Blind Obsession is unclashable and cannot be redirected, targeting Destroyed Flotsam. Let it resolve to damage the Lamp rather than trying to intercept it with a Sinner.

phases.3.steps.3.text: If intact Flotsam remains when Blind Obsession is used, its passive can deal 20 damage to a random Sinner at Turn End. Do not ignore it just because it has no actions.

phases.4.title.text: Use Shard support to damage the boss

phases.4.steps.0.text: Break the Lamp with direct attacks, Clash wins against Blind Obsession, and Wayward Blind Obsession's self-damage. It remains targetable after breaking. The Lamp takes 1.5× Pierce versus the Body's 1.0×, so Pierce attackers can keep targeting it.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Breaking it gives all Sinners Fluorescence Shard, exempting them from Siltcurrent's recurring Paralyze, Bind, and SP loss.

phases.4.steps.2.text: The Shard also supports Poise, but you must still stop Sinking attacks. Press and Sweep add Sinking Count against Shard carriers, so this is not complete status immunity.

phases.4.steps.3.text: The Lamp regenerates 2 turns later. Keep handling Flotsam and use the opening with less Paralyze to finish the boss.

mechanics.0.effect.text: All Sinners gain this when the Lamp breaks. At Turn Start, gain 3 Poise and 2 Poise Count. Siltcurrent's recurring debuffs target Sinners without this effect.

mechanics.0.response.text: It does not prevent all Sinking from attacks. Also check Press and Sweep's conditions.

mechanics.1.effect.text: The enemy's unique status causes Stagger at 3. It is separate from the Attack Skill of the same name. Do not assume this Stagger automatically stops its actions.

mechanics.1.response.text: Build it through Clash wins and self-damage while continuing to answer the currently slotted skills.

mechanics.2.effect.text: 50 HP; no actions. Reducing its HP turns it into Destroyed Flotsam, enabling and becoming the target of the next Wayward Blind Obsession.

mechanics.2.response.text: Deal at least 12 per hit and destroy it before the next Blind Obsession is selected.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Meursault's base E.G.O, which can prepare enemy debuffs for next turn.

mechanics.3.response.text: To answer the first Blind Obsession, land it on turn 1.

mechanics.4.effect.text: A Canto V dungeon aid. Raises Ishmael to Level 40 if below 40 and assists Uptie/Threadspin to IV. Grants Compulsion each battle.

mechanics.4.response.text: Prepare other main units, resistances, and healing rather than rushing to raise only Ishmael.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Ishmael begins combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.

mechanics.5.response.text: Prioritize SP recovery and durability, and watch for E.G.O Corrosion at low SP.

warnings.0.text: The Lamp can still act after breaking. Do not stop assigning Clashes simply because it is broken.

warnings.1.text: Destroying Flotsam differs from removing it entirely. Let Wayward Blind Obsession target the remaining wreckage.

warnings.2.text: The initial 1 Paralyze weakens Plus Coin skills. Choose based on current Paralyze and action order rather than the usual maximum roll.

warnings.3.text: Continue answering attacks during Stagger from the Blind Obsession status. Do not switch everyone to unopposed attacks based only on the Stagger animation.

preparation.0.text: Prepare high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills that win under Paralyze, opening enemy debuffs, and HP/SP recovery.

preparation.1.text: Assign separate Flotsam breakers and Lamp attackers, using Pride/Envy and Slash/Pierce damage.

roles.0.reason.text: Win under Paralyze and prevent Sinking Deluge.

roles.1.reason.text: Turn later Blind Obsession casts into self-damaging skills.

roles.2.reason.text: Limit recurring debuffs and create openings for your main attackers.

units.0.notes.0.text: The Body cannot be broken. Pride and Envy are effective; Blunt deals 0.5× damage.

units.0.notes.1.text: Shared skills such as Blind Obsession are assigned between Body and Lamp, prioritizing Parts that are not Staggered.

units.0.notes.2.text: Continue answering planned attacks even during Stagger caused by the Blind Obsession status.

units.1.notes.0.text: Remains targetable and can act after breaking. Regenerates 2 turns later.

units.1.notes.1.text: Losing a Clash with Blind Obsession, or completing Wayward Blind Obsession, removes HP equal to 34% of this Part's Max HP.

units.1.notes.2.text: Breaking it grants all Sinners Fluorescence Shard, reducing exposure to Siltcurrent's recurring debuffs.

units.2.notes.0.text: Does not act. Appears at Turn End from Sweep.

units.2.notes.1.text: Damage below 12 is nullified. All 3 physical resistances are 2.0, so use sufficient damage per hit.

units.2.notes.2.text: Turns into Destroyed Flotsam rather than disappearing, becoming Wayward Blind Obsession's target.

skills.0.response.text: A regular 1-Coin Blunt attack. Prevent Sinking while saving strong skills for Blind Obsession.

skills.1.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.1.response.text: Both Coins increase Sinking Count. Keep unopposed hits away from Sinners with high Sinking Potency.

skills.2.effects.1.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.2.effects.3.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.2.response.text: The Lamp's Blunt attack also increases Sinking Count on Shard carriers. Keep Clashing with it even after the Lamp breaks.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.

skills.3.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.3.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.3.response.text: A 4-Coin skill rolling 15–23, ending with Sinking Deluge. Use high Base Power or negative Coins that can win despite 1 Paralyze. Winning removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [Clash Lose] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.4.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.4.response.text: A 4-Coin skill rolling 15–23, ending with Sinking Deluge. Use high Base Power or negative Coins that can win despite 1 Paralyze. Winning removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP.

skills.5.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.5.effects.2.text: [Heads Hit] Inflict -2 SP Loss Efficiency next turn.

skills.5.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.5.response.text: Unclashable and changes the terrain. Handle regular skills and prepare for next turn's Blind Obsession instead of attempting to Clash with powerful E.G.O.

skills.6.effects.1.text: [After Attack] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.

skills.6.response.text: An unclashable, unredirectable attack targeting Destroyed Flotsam. After attacking, removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP. Let the self-damage occur rather than attempting to intercept it.

skills.7.effects.1.text: [After Attack] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.

skills.7.response.text: An unclashable, unredirectable attack targeting Destroyed Flotsam. After attacking, removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP. Let the self-damage occur rather than attempting to intercept it.

skills.8.effects.2.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.8.effects.4.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.8.response.text: Creates Flotsam at Turn End. Winning does not cancel its creation, so reserve someone to handle it afterward.

skills.9.effects.2.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.9.effects.4.text: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.

skills.9.response.text: Creates Flotsam at Turn End. Winning does not cancel its creation, so reserve someone to handle it afterward.

skills.10.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Destroy all Flotsam and Destroyed Flotsam.

skills.10.response.text: Consumes all Blind Obsession status and destroys Flotsam at Combat Start. Old wreckage will not remain usable indefinitely; check the currently slotted skill.

skills.11.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Destroy all Flotsam and Destroyed Flotsam.

skills.11.response.text: Consumes all Blind Obsession status and destroys Flotsam at Combat Start. Old wreckage will not remain usable indefinitely; check the currently slotted skill.

passives.0.effect.text: When the Lamp breaks, grant Fluorescence Shard to all enemies. The Lamp regenerates 2 turns later.

passives.0.response.text: Use Shards to limit recurring debuffs and attack before regeneration.

passives.1.effect.text: When the Lamp breaks, grant Fluorescence Shard to all enemies. The Lamp regenerates 2 turns later.

passives.1.response.text: Use Shards to limit recurring debuffs and attack before regeneration.

passives.2.effect.text: Each turn from turn 2, if the Lamp is not broken, gain 8 Poise and increase Poise Count by 3 for this turn. If the Lamp is broken, gain 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down for this turn instead.

passives.2.response.text: While broken, the enemy receives 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down too. Concentrate your main units' attacks.

passives.3.effect.text: Each turn from turn 2, if the Lamp is not broken, gain 8 Poise and increase Poise Count by 3 for this turn. If the Lamp is broken, gain 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down for this turn instead.

passives.3.response.text: While broken, the enemy receives 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down too. Concentrate your main units' attacks.

passives.4.effect.text: Each turn from turn 2, inflict 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze on Identities without Fluorescence Shard, and reduce their SP by 3.

passives.4.response.text: Break the Lamp to limit recurring debuffs.

passives.5.effect.text: Each turn from turn 2, inflict 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze on Identities without Fluorescence Shard, and reduce their SP by 3.

passives.5.response.text: Break the Lamp to limit recurring debuffs.

passives.6.response.text: Break Flotsam with strong individual hits. Small hits are not added together for this condition.

passives.7.effect.text: If Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent uses Blind Obsession and this unit remains intact at Turn End, deal 20 damage to a random Identity.

passives.7.response.text: Remove Flotsam beforehand to limit Turn End damage as well as handling Blind Obsession itself.

passives.8.effect.text: On death, HP does not reach 0. Become Destroyed Flotsam.

passives.8.response.text: Use the target that remains to trigger Wayward Blind Obsession's self-damage.
